purpose: Metadata-only admission fixtures; not full packages and never execute upstream code.

samples.manifestText:
{
  "name": "coopanion",
  "productName": "Coopanion",
  "version": "0.2.10",
  "private": true,
  "description": "A desktop companion built on Cortico: a pet on your screen that talks, listens and can operate the computer",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-or-later",
  "author": "Pal-AI-Lab",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "app/main.cjs",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.28.6",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx scripts/stage.ts && electron .",
    "start": "electron .",
    "build:cortico": "tsx scripts/stage.ts",
    "console:test": "tsx scripts/console-test.ts",
    "build:installer": "tsx scripts/stage.ts && tsx scripts/pack.ts",
    "build:icons": "electron scripts/make-icons.cjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "typecheck:web": "tsc -p tsconfig.web.json",
    "test:worlds": "vitest run --config vitest.worlds.config.ts",
    "typecheck:worlds": "tsc -p tsconfig.worlds.json"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "cortico-provider-coo": "workspace:*",
    "cortico-world-desktop-pet": "workspace:*",
    "electron-updater": "^6.8.9",
    "express": "^4.22.3",
    "pnpm": "11.28.6",
    "tsx": "^4.23.15",
    "undici": "7.29.1",
    "ws": "^8.21.3"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@codemirror/commands": "^6.11.1",
    "@codemirror/state": "^6.7.5",
    "@codemirror/view": "^6.43.12",
    "@tailwindcss/cli": "^4.3.3",
    "@types/express": "^4.17.25",
    "@types/node": "^22.20.4",
    "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/tar-stream": "3.1.4",
    "@types/ws": "^8.18.1",
    "electron": "44.4.4",
    "electron-builder": "^26.15.3",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.2",
    "fflate": "0.8.3",
    "jsdom": "^30.1.0",
    "react": "^19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "react-textarea-autosize": "^8.5.9",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3",
    "tar-stream": "3.2.1",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "vitest": "^2.1.9"
  }
}

{
  "name": "cortico-world-desktop-pet",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "Cortico World: a desktop pet that talks in bubbles, asks with options, walks, emotes, hears you through FunASR's SenseVoice or Whisper on sherpa-onnx, and can operate the computer (screenshots, mouse, keyboard and windows), yielding whenever you touch the machine",
  "author": "Pal AI Lab",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-or-later",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion.git",
    "directory": "packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/tree/main/packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet#readme",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/issues"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "cortico-world",
    "cortico",
    "desktop-pet",
    "funasr",
    "whisper",
    "computer-use",
    "desktop-automation"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.28.6",
  "main": "./src/index.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./web/*": "./web/*",
    "./webui/key-capture.ts": "./src/webui/key-capture.ts",
    "./host/*": "./host/*"
  },
  "cortico": {
    "kind": "world",
    "api": 6,
    "webUiClient": "dist/webui.js",
    "webUiStyle": "dist/webui.css",
    "describe": "describe.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src",
    "web",
    "host",
    "dist",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE",
    "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md",
    "CHANGELOG.md",
    "describe.json"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build-webui.mjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:cua-e2e": "vitest run --config vitest.cua-e2e.config.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "cortico-provider-coo": "workspace:*",
    "fflate": "0.8.3",
    "jpeg-js": "^0.4.4",
    "koffi": "3.3.1",
    "opencc-js": "^1.4.1",
    "sherpa-onnx-node": "1.13.8",
    "ws": "^8.18.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.10.0",
    "@types/ws": "^8.5.13",
    "electron": "44.4.4",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.2",
    "tsx": "^4.19.2",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2",
    "vitest": "^2.1.8"
  }
}
